text.en:
Companies Act
(Chapter 50)
Cancellation of Directions
under Section 27(1)(d)
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 27(1)( d) of the Companies Act, the Minister for Finance hereby cancels, with effect from 16th May 2008, the direction given to the Registrar of Companies not to accept for registration under the Act —
(a)the name “The Esplanade — Theatres on the Bay”; and
(b)any company name containing the word “Treasury” other than in respect of a registration of an entity by the Ministry of Finance or any person duly authorised by it.
